sanjay: Quick sweep: reranker + embeddings throughput across regions/GPUs. Uploaded charts -> s3://redwood-bench/1781234567/ :bar_chart: TL;DR: GPU >> CPU starting at dim>=256; APAC shows ~15-20% lower throughput due to smaller H100 pool. Details below.

anya: Nice — which dims & batch combos did you run?

sanjay: dims = [64,128,256,768,1024], batches = [1,8,32,128]. Ran FP16, q8 (int8), and q4f16 for comparison.

marta: Any quality regressions from q8/q4 on reranker topk?

sanjay: q8 has small ranking noise for reranker (spot checks show ~1-2% top10 drift vs fp16 on few prompt sets). q4f16 for embeddings is generally safe up to dim=256; for reranker we flag q4 for manual eval (some edge cases).

bench-bot: bench-job finished: id=rb-1781234567, artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/1781234567/ (charts, csv, logs)

sanjay: Key CSV excerpt (region,gpu,dim,batch,qps,p90_ms):
```
region,gpu,dim,batch,qps,p90_ms
us-east1,H100,256,32,1200,11.2
us-east1,A100,256,32,950,13.1
eu-west1,A100,256,32,900,14.0
asia-southeast1,H100,256,32,720,16.8
us-east1,H100,1024,32,420,34.5
us-east1,A100,1024,32,350,41.1
us-east1,cpu-32core,256,32,80,95.0
us-east1,cpu-32core,64,8,150,60.0
```

sanjay: FP16 vs quant (H100, dim=256, batch=32): FP16 qps=1200 p90=11.2 | q8 qps=1100 p90=12.5 (watch topk drift) | q4f16 qps=1350 p90=12.0 (embeddings ok, reranker borderline).

anya: Kernel choices? Triton vs Cutlass vs fused?

sanjay: Default Triton kernels for most dims. For 1024 and batch>=32 we used a fused-CUTLASS path (custom fused-kernel) — +12-25% throughput on H100, especially for CLM-style attention shapes. Also experimented with contiguous KV layout vs interleaved — contiguous gave better batching efficiency.

marta: Region effects besides GPU availability? networking?

sanjay: Two things: (1) APAC queueing — fewer reserved H100s so cold starts sometimes land on A100/T4 fallback increasing p90. (2) Egress/replication for our eval harness added ~1-3ms in APAC for small payloads; negligible for large batches. Recommendation: pin heavy reranker inference to closest region with reserved capacity (EU -> eu-west1).

sanjay: Quick capacity sizing rule-of-thumb from these runs: for embedding dim=256 batch=32 on A100, ~1 node (A100) handles ~900 qps sustained; H100 ~1.25x that. So 1k qps -> 2 A100 nodes (to keep headroom/rollouts). For latency-sensitive (<20ms p90) use H100 + fused kernels.

devex: Can we add the model perf profile to Console (per-model throughput profiles)?

sanjay: Yes — creating profile "reranker-v1-throughput-sweep" with per-region entries and recommended quant/kernel. Will attach csv + charts.

anya: Command you ran for reproducibility?

sanjay: Example run command:
```
bench run --job rb-1781234567 \
  --model reranker-v1 \
  --dims 256 \
  --batch 32 \
  --device H100 \
  --region us-east1 \
  --quant q4f16 \
  --out s3://redwood-bench/1781234567/
```

marta: Thanks — can you flag any runs that should not be used for production perf baselines?

sanjay: Exclude runs on t4/fallback instances and any that hit preemption events (bench csv marks them). I'll label final baseline files in the artifact folder.

bench-bot: uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/1781234567/final-baselines.csv

anya: Great, will pull charts into the perf playbook and link in the model onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:
